Type: chair
Name: Stone & Beam Leather Swivel Office Chair on Wheels, 26.4"W, Brown
Colors: Brown
Materials: Top-Grain Leather Upholstery; Wood And Metal Swivel Base; Metal Wheels
A tall curved back and top-grain leather upholstery give this swivel chair a strong presence in a home office. The back and armrests feature classic mid-century tufting. Firm cushioning and elastic webbing make it durable and comfortable. 26.4"W x 23.2"D x 41"H Top-grain leather upholstery; wood and metal swivel base; metal wheels. 360 degree swivel. Sturdy for up to 250 lb capacity. Top-grain leather shows unique markings. Easy assembly in 15 minutes. Wipe with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
